purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Kulaura

queries.query: Kulaura Bangladesh official cadastral map parcel land records mouza map
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Government of Bangladesh DLRS Integrated Online Map Purchase System, the national land-zoning/mouza viewer, and the official Kulaura Upazila Land Office. The DLRS public API enumerated Kulaura mouza-map records.

queries.result: বাংলা অনুসন্ধানে কুলাউড়া উপজেলা ভূমি অফিসের সরকারি পোর্টাল, ভূমি রেকর্ড ও জরিপ অধিদপ্তরের মৌজা-ম্যাপ নির্দেশনা, এবং সরকারি ভূমি নকশা পোর্টাল পাওয়া গেছে।

registryEvidence.basis: The official Kulaura Upazila Land Office portal identifies the local land-office custodian; the first-party DLRS map service returned Kulaura mouza records under Sylhet division and Moulvibazar district.
registryEvidence.localCustodianScope: Kulaura Upazila Land Office, Moulvibazar. The national Department of Land Records and Surveys is the map/survey service custodian. This evidences a local registry office and public map service, not complete citywide parcel-vector coverage.

officialSources.observation: Official Kulaura Upazila Land Office portal under the Bangladesh government domain.
Current first-party DLRS Integrated Online Map Purchase System; public search supports division, district, upazila, mouza, sheet and survey type.
Current Government of Bangladesh mouza-and-plot based national digital land zoning viewer; page states mouza maps are digitized and geo-referenced.
DLRS instructions identify official channels for obtaining mouza maps and cadastral records.

source.name: Bangladesh DLRS Integrated Online Map Purchase System and national land-zoning viewer
source.compositeKeyProvenance: The API returned a stable-looking map-document id, but this is a map-document identity rather than a verified parcel identity. No parcel polygon or parcel-level native identity was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: DLRS public map-document search for the selected Kulaura mouza and the national land-zoning viewer's published mouza/plot service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Kulaura mouza JL ৩৭ and three available public map-document records were enumerated. No anonymous parcel polygon response was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point was preserved and not moved. The map search confirms public Kulaura mouza map metadata but does not establish parcel-vector availability, citywide coverage, municipal-boundary correspondence, stable parcel identity semantics, or a usable CRS. The referenced GeoServer WFS route returned 503. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
